description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5915005039797 FILTER,RADIO FREQUE: Line 0001 Qty 9 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0246 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract). The Guaranteed Minimum quantity will be 1. Items will be shipped to various CONUS and OCONUS (via consolidation and containerization point) DLA Depots. Approved sources are 13619 JN14-1539A; 95802 220238-001; 95802 450430-5. The solicitation is an RFQ and will be available at the link provided in this notice. Hard copies of this solicitation are not available. Specifications, plans, or drawings are not available. All responsible sources may submit a quote which, if timely received, shall be considered. Quotes must be submitted electronically.
